scope: Existing loaded AQA Physics Waves 3.3 and Electricity 3.5 school-mock manual-application traceability, not independent assessment of the student or new flashcards.
methods: Map each of the seven v360 Waves gates and four v359 Electricity gates to original practice already in the runtime manifest.
Check actual question IDs, specRef, subject, mock flag and published model-answer/rubric existence in CI.
Distinguish an available worked or drawn exercise from a fully independent examiner-validated marking or student response.
Never infer that a recall flashcard itself demonstrates practical method competence.

gates.skill: Progressive displacement/time graphs, phase and time shift
gates.remaining: A genuinely unfamiliar progressive-wave displacement graph with axes and time-shift interpretation still needs independent marking.

gates.skill: Transverse and longitudinal wave diagrams, polarisation and aerial direction
gates.remaining: Verify an actual longitudinal/transverse particle-displacement sketch and an unseen polariser/aerial diagram; explanation-only problems are not equivalent to drawn evidence.

gates.skill: Required Practical 1 stationary-string method, harmonics and f²–tension interpretation
gates.remaining: Complete apparatus and method justification, unfamiliar measurement uncertainty, and actual student string sketches remain unchecked.

gates.skill: Required Practical 2 Young double-slit interference and grating evidence
gates.remaining: The independently reviewed full Young apparatus geometry and fringe diagram with uncertainty explanation is still a separate assessment gate.

gates.skill: Qualitative single-slit diffraction and grating patterns
gates.remaining: Check actual central-maximum/side-lobe sketches and correct physics, not merely a prompt or text description.

gates.skill: Fibre TIR ray path, core–cladding angles and pulse broadening
gates.remaining: Verify the angle-to-normal ray drawing, total internal reflection and materially accurate modal/material dispersion explanations from actual student evidence.

gates.skill: Historical evidence concerning light as a wave and later photon models
gates.remaining: Read and compare the actual AQA historical point; verify whether a suitable short application is needed rather than inventing a syllabus statement.

gates.skill: Full ohmic, filament lamp and diode I–V curves
gates.remaining: Independently inspect all three actual drawn curves, polarities, quadrants, labels and explanations.

gates.skill: Required Practical 5 wire resistivity circuit, measurements, gradient and uncertainties
gates.remaining: Evaluate actual drawn circuit and graph, defensible measured uncertainties and reasoned interpretation.

gates.skill: NTC/LDR potential dividers and output directions
gates.remaining: Verify that the student has placed the sensor and output terminals correctly and proved output direction for each.

gates.skill: Required Practical 6 emf and internal resistance graph/circuit/uncertainty
gates.remaining: Verify the student's own V–I slope/intercept, circuit drawing, lost-volts and uncertainty reasoning.

integrity: No question, card, stored answer, score, XP, saved profile, cloud key or loader changed by this editorial map.
